confidence_notes: I did two web searches. The first returned the RBA reference rate of 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 November 2026. That figure came through a search summary that cited the RBA exchange rates page, and I did not open the RBA page itself. The second search found crowdsourced cost-of-living figures for Tromso. They put a pint of domestic beer at about NOK 103-111, a mid-range cappuccino at about NOK 58-62 and a basic restaurant meal at about NOK 252-282. I converted these to USD at roughly 10.5-11 NOK per USD. That rate is my own approximation, and I did not search for it. Crowdsourced figures come with wide ranges. I estimated the mid-range meal for two from the inexpensive-meal price and typical Norwegian restaurant pricing. I also did not search for cocktail or wine prices. I scaled them from the beer price using typical Norwegian bar ratios, so they are less certain. Accommodation figures are estimates from general knowledge only, set for July peak midnight-sun demand in a small hotel market with limited hostel supply. I did not check booking sites, so these are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: I priced Tromso like Bergen and Oslo, adjusted for Arctic tourist demand. Its restaurant prices are higher than those of other Western European cities. In July, demand for its limited hotel rooms is high, similar to Reykjavik in summer.
